customer: Honestly this is getting annoying. We're cutting down to one car so I'm selling my station wagon, and the first thing someone tells me is that the mods I put in might actually lower what I get? I spent good money on that custom stereo and the exhaust, so what's the deal?
agent: I understand the frustration, especially after investing in those upgrades. As our article "Cars with aftermarket modifications" explains, modifications rarely add value, and things like loud exhausts usually lower the offer because we may need to return the car to factory condition. If you'd like to keep the custom stereo, please remove it before the appraisal. If any modification changes your offer, the specialist will show you why, and you can also read more in "What can change your offer."
